Contact us

Help improve a calculation or report a problem.

For calculation errors, accessibility issues or privacy requests, email Info@gradetargetcalc.com.

Reporting a calculation issue

Include the calculator name, non-sensitive example inputs, the result you expected and the result shown. If possible, explain the formula or syllabus rule involved. For a display problem, include your device and browser name.

Protect your privacy

Please do not send student IDs, transcripts, passwords or other private records. We cannot access or amend official academic results. Your institution is the right contact for grading decisions.
